checkpoints.quote:
Current assignee: Hana Sato, as of 2026-09-09.
- Ownership history: Priya Nair (from creation 2026-07-01) → Ravi Kumar (2026-08-18) → Hana Sato (2026-09-09).
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states Hana Sato is the current owner, took over from Ravi Kumar on 2026-09-09, and Ravi had taken it from Priya Nair in August.

checkpoints.quote: 2026-08-05 (Aroha Walker, agreed with Dev and Priya): Statements will be sent as secure download links, not attachments. This overrides the earlier (2026-07-10) plan to compress PDFs and fall back to SMTP for oversized files. Attachments are explicitly out of scope.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly conveys the 2026-08-05 decision to use secure download links, that attachments are out of scope, and that it replaced the July compression plan.

checkpoints.quote: 2026-08-20 (Dev Patel): SMTP relay stays as a fallback until 2026-12-31; EmailHub sending will be gated behind a feature flag EMAILHUB_ENABLED so it can be switched off without a deploy.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states the 2026-08-20 decision: SMTP fallback until 2026-12-31 and the EMAILHUB_ENABLED feature flag.

checkpoints.quote:
EmailHub client — built (per Ravi's handover; also reflected by months of ongoing CI activity on feature/emailhub).
- Templates — migrated (per Ravi's handover).
- Bounce/complaint webhook handling — Hana confirmed on 2026-09-12: "Bounce and complaint webhook handling is done and merged (PR #230)."
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly lists all three completed items: EmailHub client, templates, and bounce/complaint webhook handling with PR #230.

checkpoints.quote:
Load test at 3x peak volume — the only remaining scope item per Hana's latest update (2026-09-14):
  > "Load test is the only thing left. It's blocked until we get the performance environment, which is booked for the week of 2026-09-21."
checkpoints.reason: The analysis clearly states the load test at 3x peak is the only remaining work and is blocked until the performance environment in the week of 2026-09-21.

checkpoints.quote: the original 10 MB attachment-size problem (EH-413 error, reported 2026-07-03) appears to have been resolved by decision #1 rather than by compression
checkpoints.reason: The analysis mentions the 10 MB limit, the EH-413 error, and connects it to the download-link decision, conveying that the limit was the driver for the switch.
The analysis correctly identifies Hana Sato as the current owner and only mentions Ravi Kumar and Priya Nair in the historical ownership chain.
The analysis explicitly states the July compression plan was 'overridden' by the August 5 decision and does not present it as the current approach.
